summary.en: Asian equity markets fell sharply on Friday as traders priced in potential data-center spending constraints from new state-level political leadership, with the Nikkei 225 down 6% and South Korea's KOSPI down 6%. The BLS reported October nonfarm payrolls rose 165,000—well above the 48,000 twelve-month average—with the unemployment rate at 4.1% and average hourly earnings up 0.4% month over month to $38.00. US equity futures point modestly higher this morning (NQ +1.53%, ES +0.18%) after Thursday's broad selloff, while the 10-year Treasury yield ticked up 3.1 basis points to 4.868%.
summary.zh: 周五亚洲股市大幅下跌，交易员担忧新任州级政治领导层可能限制数据中心支出，日经225指数下跌6%，韩国KOSPI指数下跌6%。美国劳工统计局报告10月非农就业新增16.5万，远高于12个月均值4.8万，失业率变化不大，为4.1%，平均时薪环比上涨0.4%至$38.00。周四美股大幅下跌后，今晨美股期货小幅走高（NQ +1.53%，ES +0.18%），10年期美债收益率上行3.1个基点至4.868%。

title.en: Asian markets fall sharply on data-center policy concerns; Nikkei -6%, KOSPI -6%, MSCI APAC -3.9%
title.zh: 亚洲股市因数据中心政策担忧大幅下跌；日经225跌6%，KOSPI跌6%，MSCI亚太跌3.9%

impact.en: MT Newswires reported Asian exchanges broadly fell Friday as traders worried new political leadership in Washington could cramp the data-center spending boom and cut chip demand. The Nikkei 225 dropped 3,643.13 points to 57,434.77 (-6%), KOSPI fell 6% with SK Hynix down 10.4%, the Hang Seng lost 1.3%, and the TWSE declined 4.5%. Brent crude rose 1.3% to $96.83 during Asian hours, adding to negative sentiment. This extends the prior US session's tech selloff (Nasdaq -5.49%, SOXX -12.91%) into the Asia-Pacific tape.
impact.zh: MT Newswires报道，周五亚洲各交易所普遍下跌，交易员担忧华盛顿新任政治领导层可能限制数据中心支出热潮并削减芯片需求。日经225指数下跌3,643.13点至57,434.77（-6%），KOSPI跌6%（SK Hynix跌10.4%），恒生指数跌1.3%，台湾加权指数跌4.5%。亚洲交易时段布伦特原油上涨1.3%至$96.83，加剧负面情绪。此轮下跌延续了前一交易日美股科技股抛售（纳指-5.49%，SOXX -12.91%）至亚太盘面。

bearish: en: SK Hynix -10.4% and Nikkei -6% show AI-chip selling pressure is spreading across Asia, not contained to US-listed semis
zh: SK Hynix跌10.4%、日经跌6%表明AI芯片抛售压力正在向亚洲扩散，并非仅限于美股半导体板块

macroRisk.en: Data-center policy risk at the state level could compress the capex cycle that underpins US tech earnings.
macroRisk.zh: 州级数据中心政策风险可能压缩支撑美国科技股盈利的资本开支周期。

title.en: BLS: October nonfarm payrolls +165,000; unemployment 4.1%; avg hourly earnings +0.4% MoM to $38.00
title.zh: BLS：10月非农就业新增16.5万；失业率4.1%；平均时薪环比上涨0.4%至$38.00

impact.en: The BLS reported total nonfarm payroll employment rose 165,000 in October, well above the 48,000 average monthly gain over the prior 12 months. The unemployment rate changed little at 4.1%. Average hourly earnings rose 0.4% month over month to $38.00, with 12-month growth at 3.1%. August was revised up 53,000 (to +186,000) and September up 31,000 (to +60,000). Gains were led by professional and business services (+70,000), health care (+42,000), and transportation and warehousing (+25,000). Part-time employment for economic reasons increased 339,000 to 4.8 million.
impact.zh: 美国劳工统计局报告10月非农就业新增16.5万，远高于此前12个月月均4.8万。失业率变化不大，为4.1%。平均时薪环比上涨0.4%至$38.00，12个月增速为3.1%。8月上修5.3万（至+18.6万），9月上修3.1万（至+6.0万）。新增就业主要由专业及商业服务（+7.0万）、医疗保健（+4.2万）和运输仓储（+2.5万）贡献。因经济原因兼职就业增加33.9万至480万。

bullish: en: 165K payrolls vs 48K 12-month average and upward revisions to Aug/Sep support a resilient-growth narrative
zh: 16.5万非农远超12个月均值4.8万，且8/9月上修，支撑经济韧性叙事
bearish: en: Part-time for economic reasons up 339K to 4.8M hints at underlying labor-market softness beneath the headline
zh: 因经济原因兼职就业增加33.9万至480万，暗示总量数据背后劳动力市场存在隐忧

macroRisk.en: A 165K print with 3.1% wage growth may reduce near-term rate-cut urgency if policymakers view labor demand as sufficiently resilient.
macroRisk.zh: 16.5万就业与3.1%工资增速若被政策制定者视为劳动力需求仍具韧性，可能降低近期降息的紧迫性。

keyRisk.en: The 10Y yield at 4.868% and DXY at 102.25 are the main headwinds to the NQ futures repair. If yields push toward 4.90% or above, the repair thesis weakens materially.
keyRisk.zh: 10年期收益率4.868%和美元指数102.25是NQ期货修复的主要逆风。若收益率逼近4.90%或更高，修复逻辑将显著减弱。

note.en: The prior session's sharp tech selloff—Nasdaq down 5.49%, SOXX down 12.91%—coincided with post-midterm data-center policy concerns, and this morning's NQ futures gain of 1.53% reads as an attempted repair rather than a confirmed reversal. Two signals support a cautious recovery: the BLS print showing 165,000 payrolls well above the 48,000 twelve-month average, and the modest ES futures uptick. The most important conflicting signal is the 10-year Treasury yield rising 3.1 basis points to 4.868% alongside a 0.64% DXY gain, which suggests the macro backdrop is not yet fully supportive of a broad risk-on rotation. I lean toward the repair being fragile unless yields stabilize. Watchpoint: if NQ futures hold above the prior close reference while the 10-year yield stays below 4.90%, the repair thesis gains support; a yield push above that level with continued DXY strength would weaken it.
note.zh: 前一交易日科技股大幅下跌——纳指跌5.49%、SOXX跌12.91%——伴随中期选举后数据中心政策担忧加剧，今晨NQ期货上涨1.53%更像是修复尝试而非趋势反转。两个信号支持谨慎修复：BLS数据显示10月非农新增16.5万，远高于12个月均值4.8万；ES期货小幅走高。最重要的矛盾信号是10年期美债收益率上行3.1个基点至4.868%，同时美元指数上涨0.64%，表明宏观环境尚未完全支持广泛的风险偏好回升。我倾向于认为修复较为脆弱，除非收益率企稳。观察点：若NQ期货守住前收盘价参考位且10年期收益率维持在4.90%以下，修复逻辑获得支撑；若收益率突破该水平且美元继续走强，则修复逻辑减弱。
